_header.purpose: Append-only ledger of assumptions, decisions and blockers. JSON has no comments, so this _header object stands in for a header comment.
_header.mission: Path of the brief this ledger belongs to.
_header.started_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first step, or null before the mission starts.
_header.entries: Array of entries. Agents append; they never edit or delete.

entry.step: integer step number the entry belongs to
entry.summary: string; for ASSUMPTION this is the question
entry.detail: string; for ASSUMPTION this is the default chosen and why
